# ascii-sharks vendor snapshot

These TypeScript sources are the pinned reference snapshot. Whale Tide does
not import them at runtime; `lib/client.js` is a hand-written JavaScript port
for the DSH browser module loader. The snapshot is kept so the MIT attribution
and the exact adapted mechanics travel with the repository.
